route.summaryZh: 公园游玩 → 早点吃饭 → 小巷艺术节
steps: Eat Street, Church Street, Parramatta NSW
route.noteZh: 仅适用于23、24日。公园官网列有游乐场和野餐设施，Church Street 是餐饮街；选哪家店需另外确认营业与位置。晚上按节庆地图挑站点，出发前查道路封闭。
route.noteEn: For 23–24 October only. The park lists playgrounds and picnic facilities; Church Street offers dining. Check your chosen restaurant's hours and location separately, then select festival stops from the map and check road closures.
route.evidence: Park authority confirms two playgrounds and picnic facilities; AT Parramatta confirms Church Street dining and Lanes Friday/Saturday 5-10:30pm. These are separate named stops; no journey duration or restaurant hours asserted.

route.summaryZh: 魔法展 → 公园野餐 → 湖畔散步
steps: Paddington Pavilion, Sydney Showground, Sydney Olympic Park NSW
Bicentennial Park, Sydney Olympic Park NSW
Lake Belvedere, Sydney Olympic Park NSW
route.noteZh: 先选上午或中午可预约的场次，再转去公园野餐；两个场地需另行移动。公园有步道和湖畔野餐空间，按天气量力走，展内不能带推车。
route.noteEn: Book an available morning or midday session, then transfer to the park for a picnic. The venues are separate; follow park paths and lakeside picnic areas as weather allows. Strollers are not allowed inside the exhibition.
route.evidence: Exhibition current hours and no-stroller condition rechecked. Park authority identifies shared paths and Lake Belvedere picnic pavilion. Route is an optional separate-venue suggestion, not a timed itinerary or invented adjacent entrance.

route.summaryZh: 文化节与午餐 → ACMI 互动影像展
route.summaryEn: Festival and lunch → ACMI screen play
steps: The Story of the Moving Image, ACMI
route.noteZh: 仅24日可组合文化节。ACMI 免费常设展开放至17:00，可以先看展再回广场；有闪烁展示，敏感家庭先查看参观提示。午餐从节庆餐摊自行选择。
route.noteEn: Combine the festival on 24 October only. ACMI's free permanent exhibition closes at 5pm, so you can visit it first and return to the square. Check strobing warnings if sensitive; choose lunch from festival food stalls.
route.evidence: Venue verifies 24 October festival at Fed Square with food stalls; ACMI exact exhibition page confirms Ground Floor Fed Square, free entry 10am-5pm, strobing warning. No assumed travel time or third-party restaurant hours.

route.summaryZh: ArtPlay 爵士创作 → ACMI 互动影像展
steps: The Story of the Moving Image, ACMI
route.noteZh: 仅23–25日。先参加2–7岁适用的亲子音乐创作，再按体力决定要不要去 ACMI；后者至17:00、免费，部分展示有闪烁效果。不要默认 ArtPlay 门口游乐设施开放。
route.noteEn: For 23–25 October only. Start with the ages 2–7 adult-accompanied music session, then add ACMI only if everyone has energy. It is free until 5pm with some strobing displays. Nearby outdoor playground availability is not assumed.
route.evidence: Jazz festival gives ArtPlay address and session 10:30am-12:30pm through 25 October; ACMI confirms Fed Square Ground Floor, free until 5pm. Both are named verified city-centre stops, no journey times or unverified playground opening claimed.
